Excellent! Very polite and great service 👍👍👍 10/10! …
The service was terrible and very slow.

Today I went to the dental clinic. The staff handing out queue numbers seemed a bit grumpy. Some were nice and spoke well. When it was my turn, I sat on the chair, rinsed with antiseptic, and was about to spit it out when I pulled out a tissue (3 thin, small, and not-so-good quality sheets). The dental assistant said, "Don't pull out so much, it's wasteful. We paid for these ourselves, we didn't get any reimbursement. It's wasteful." Huh?! What am I supposed to do with those 3 sheets of tissue? I read reviews but didn't expect to experience this myself. And when they called my name the first time, I walked over. Then another patient came in and asked questions, so I had to sit and wait until they finished talking. When they called my name a second time, their tone became much more demanding.
The staff were polite and helpful, but there was a little bit of a wait.

I went to get my son vaccinated, and the dentist was checking the baby's teeth. She asked me if he had any. I'm Thai, but I understand a little Siamese. But as a doctor, you should at least try to understand, or at least give a hint so they understand, or use a little English. There's never any English term in the language? When we don't understand, you just ramble and get defensive. We understand what you're saying, but I respect you only because you're older. You don't deserve the title of "doctor." We understand that you are tired of many people, but if you cannot help or serve people, it is better not to serve and complain. You don't deserve the title of "doctor." We understand you're tired of dealing with so many people, but if you can't help or serve people, you should just stay quiet and keep complaining.

I waited for an extremely long time, even though there were no other people. I waited for hours to get my wound treated, from morning until past noon. At 11:30, the staff immediately took a break. It was terrible. And the waiting area was hot, while the staff were comfortably inside their rooms, completely ignoring the public.
I would like to ask if I can use my universal healthcare card or welfare card for treatment?

In the past, every time I've been here, I've been impressed with the good service. But this time was really not okay. When the staff called me to the examination room, I couldn't really hear them. As soon as they called me in, the nurse said, "If you can't hear me, I'll just skip ahead. I won't call you anymore. I'm too lazy." I was very disappointed. I never expected to hear that from a nurse.
There weren't many people, but the wait was extremely long!!! Please improve this. I beg you! 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻 …

I waited for so long. I don't know what I was waiting for. It was incredibly, unbelievably long, even though there was nobody around.

text: I used to use services at Nomjit Clinic, but the new government imposed outstanding payments, so it had to close. That's why I'm using this clinic for the first time. There might be a bit of a wait, but I could feel that the doctor was calm, unpretentious, friendly, and attentive to every patient. Although the place might not be as luxurious as some others, I was very impressed with my first visit.

I arrived at the clinic at 9 am. There were quite a few patients. The staff provided excellent service. Parking on the street was convenient as the street was wide. Dr. Ploi was very kind and prescribed medication for my niece's allergies, which was very effective.

I've been here twice and the service is excellent. They're attentive, helpful, and the doctors and staff are all very nice. I just found the best service here. I went there in March and will be back tomorrow. Thank you for your attention. Thank you very much.

The wait time wasn't too long, and the staff downstairs were helpful and answered questions well. However, the dentist was terrible. Never go back there again; I've never had a bad experience. I went for a filling and wanted a tooth-colored filling. They asked why I had to choose. Well, I'm paying for it, not asking for free service, so I should have the right to choose. Otherwise, why would they list the service fees?

I arrived for my dental appointment at 6 am. A lovely staff member from the central office was there early to guide me, as it was my first time. Around 7 am, another staff member greeted me; she was so kind and gave great advice to those waiting.

I came for a teeth cleaning today; it's been a very long time since I've had it done. The dentist was excellent. I didn't hear everything she said, so I asked her again. She gave great advice on what to do and how to use my insurance. My teeth feel so clean and refreshed!
Thank you to the National Health Security Office (NHSO) and Center 35 for being such a great source of healthcare for the public. It's so fortunate to have free services with such kindness. I want to encourage all the staff; you are all very important! :) :)
author_name: Ann แอน ปุณณ์ภัสสร

text:
The staff and nurses here are quite good.
At first, I was worried and scared based on the reviews.

When I tested positive for COVID, they told me where to go and what forms to fill out. Then the doctor came to take my medical history, talked to me, explained the medication details, benefits, and side effects. 🙏
I felt much more at ease.
Do you have a contact number? The number listed on the page is not working.

I went to have a tooth extracted. Before going, I was prepared because someone told me that the staff at the front of the building and the pharmacist in finance provided good service. However, the doctor's mouth was not very good, speaking to the patients curtly and in a harsh tone. When I looked up and talked to the assistant nurse, her voice was cheerful and chattering happily. I don't know what's wrong with her towards the patients. Her words should be like cutting a dog out of her mouth. The system is very messed up. The finance department at the clinic told me that I could just take the receipt and get reimbursed. When I went to fill out the form to claim social security, the staff said that I couldn't, that a medical certificate was required. In the end, I had to bring the form from the Social Security Office to the doctor, specifying the tooth that was extracted and signing it, and then come to the next day to proceed with the process. Instead of telling me what happened to the finance department, I felt dizzy and my mouth was numb. They do a terrible job.

I'd like to ask what days the vaccination clinic is open?
And are there any fees?
I recently brought my child to stay with me, so I'd like to know the details.

Terrible. They don't care about patients at all. Their attitude is awful. Absolutely terrible. If you don't have the heart to serve the public, you don't deserve to work and be paid by taxpayers' money like this.
